notes: the two branches (ح) meet at الأعمش; the text writes «عن الأعمش، عن شقيق» once after the last «ح»

«قال كنا جلوسا عند باب عبد الله» is Shaqiq's own first-person account; whether the Companion «خرج علينا عبد الله فقال» (the speaker of the saying) is a further link is not written as a transmission, so it is left open (rule 11)
«واللفظ له» is a gloss and is left out
